<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 127.0997 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈126.092 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass within typical experimental error is C₈H₁₄O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
